entries.title: Flowtime Tiers: new Free & Pro tiers arrive in one week
entries.subtitle: Flowtime: new Free & Pro tiers arrive in one week

slides.label: ANNOUNCEMENT
slides.title: Flowtime Tiers: new Free & Pro tiers arrive in one week
slides.description:
A quick reminder about the updated Flowtime tiers, taking effect on September 1st.

The core timer and Pomodoro will remain free. Some of the more advanced features will become part of Flowtime Pro.

As a thank you to everyone already using Flowtime, there will also be a 50% discount on Pro when the new tiers launch.

Nothing you need to do right now. I just wanted to make sure nobody is surprised by the change. 
Thank you for using Flowtime!

slides.label: ANNOUNCEMENT
slides.title: Important update to Flowtime tiers!
slides.description:
Hi everyone,

I wanted to let you know about an upcoming change to Flowtime.

Starting September 1st, Flowtime will introduce a new Free and Pro structure. My goal is to keep the free version a great, privacy-first focus timer while making continued development of new features sustainable.

slides.label: NEW
slides.title: Free
items: Standard Timer
Standard notifications
Pomodoro (fixed intervals)
1 Project
1 day of History

slides.label: NEW
slides.title: Pro
items: Flow Sessions
Flowmodoro
Custom Pomodoro intervals
Unlimited Projects
Unlimited History
App Blocking
Quick Start Templates
Reminder Profiles
UI customization (accent colors)
Reports & Exports
All future pro features

slides.label: NEW
slides.title: Thank you!
slides.description:
Thank you for being an early supporter of Flowtime. 
Every download, review, bug report, and feature suggestion has helped shape the app into what it is today.

As a small thank you, Flowtime Pro will be available at 50% off for a limited time after the update launches on September 1st. If you've been thinking about supporting the project, this will be the best opportunity to do so.

Flowtime will continue to be privacy-first, require no account, and remain free from ads.

Thank you for being part of the journey.

slides.label: PRIVACY
slides.title: Anonymous Usage Analytics
slides.description: Flowtime uses TelemetryDeck to collect anonymous usage statistics. These analytics help improve the app by identifying crashes, feature usage, and performance issues. No advertising identifiers are collected, no user profiles are created, and the collected information is not used for advertising or cross-app tracking.
